events.text_en: Ôn Châu Liêm, co-founder of Nam Phố Đường, goes home to Châu Liêm Trấn to die, and the dusk half of the founders' art goes with him.
Nghiêm Họa Đống dies at dawn with a brush in her hand; Châu Phi Vân becomes hall-mistress of Nam Phố Đường.
Nam Phố's scribes paint a hundred fire talismans on a Lạc Hà order for clearing the reed beds at Thủy Khẩu; a month later Lãng Đào's boats burn at Đào Sa.
An unsigned bundle of ward talismans comes down the river to Lãng Đào's rebuilt ferries, and comes again every year after.
